soundness_flags.label: ass:unique-codebooks and ass:curvature
soundness_flags.one_line: Pollard's fixed-k conditions do not establish the asserted resolution-uniform uniqueness or a K-dependent positive-Hessian condition, so these must be retagged novel and justified as a triangular-regime restriction.

soundness_flags.label: ass:margin
soundness_flags.one_line: Levrard's cited margin condition is a fixed-k linear boundary-mass condition with coupled geometric constants, not the stated arbitrary-exponent, cell-radius-normalized, resolution-dependent triangular condition.

soundness_flags.label: ass:bounded-feature
soundness_flags.one_line: Since Y is already constrained to [-1,1], the definitions of mu_a and b imply b(X) in [0,1]; this need not be a separate class assumption.

soundness_flags.label: ass:interior-codebooks
soundness_flags.one_line: C_{P,K} is defined by optimization over K-point subsets of (0,1), so its asserted interior membership already follows from the definition whenever that minimizer exists.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 919-926, theorem setting and fixed-distribution fixed-k formulation
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article establishes asymptotic normality for k-means centers under a fixed sampling distribution and a fixed number of centers; it does not state a triangular, resolution-uniform uniqueness or curvature condition.

The cited margin condition controls the fixed-k boundary-neighborhood weight p(t) by a linear bound p(t) ≤ B p_min t/(128 M²) on a fixed radius; it is not the proposal's arbitrary-alpha, s_{P,K}-scaled, K-uniform condition.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper constructs a cross-fitted corrected estimator for a fixed number of clusters and gives fixed-resolution efficient asymptotic normality for the optimal risk; it does not state growing-resolution simultaneous profile inference.

The paper develops simultaneous confidence bands for many functional parameters from approximately Neyman-orthogonal score functions under uniform high-dimensional CLT conditions; it begins from supplied score systems.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper provides high-dimensional Gaussian and multiplier-bootstrap approximation for standardized sums, rather than optimized causal quantizer expansions.
The paper addresses inference for supplied moment inequalities through generalized moment selection, not reoptimized causal quantization profiles.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag the growing-K uniqueness, curvature, and margin conditions as novel triangular-regime assumptions; give each a concrete sufficient distributional condition and verify it on the uniform witness.

Make the polynomial ceiling a sharp comparison by deriving a multi-coordinate Assouad or Le Cam converse for at least one nondegenerate subclass, rather than only the coordinatewise separation lower bound.

State a practical sufficient route for the uniform nuisance-rate condition, such as a named smoothness or sparsity class and learner, so the headline is not read as relying on an unexplained oracle uniform-error regime.
